The name Innes is believed to have originated from the Scottish Gaelic word 'Innis', which means 'island' or 'inhabitant of an island'. In Scottish history, this name was often given to children born on an island or to those who lived near one. The name has a strong, graceful, and resilient sound, which makes it an excellent choice for both boys and girls.
